findings.title: [P2] Preserve empty trimmed names as required by the existing contract
findings.body: For `profile.name === ""` or a whitespace-only string, `trim()` produces `""`. Changing the fallback from `??` to `||` now returns `"Anonymous"` instead of the previous empty string, so this refactor changes observable behavior despite the PR's stated intent to preserve existing contracts. Keep the nullish fallback, or explicitly establish and test the new behavior.
